messages:
maria_s: Heads-up: BetaCorp escalated. Theyre seeing intermittent 401s, a billing "charge failed" modal on retry, and occasional 1.5-2s tail latency spikes. Can someone paste a short, copy/paste checklist I can send them?

alex_h: Keep it tiny and actionable. Ask for: exact ISO timestamps (start/end + timezone), the API route and model, whether they used SDK or curl, the region, any proxy or CDN in front, request IDs or trace IDs, and screenshots of the error payloads.

eng_oncall: Add where to find IDs in our tooling: Console > Observability > Requests. Filter by time window, click a row, the panel shows "Request ID" and "Trace ID". Also SDKs return headers: look for `x-redwood-request-id` or `x-request-id`.

sam_ops: Copy/paste repro snippets for non-engineers:

sam_ops: CURL (verbose, shows headers):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Tell them to copy the `x-redwood-request-id` or `x-request-id` line from the `-v` output. It will appear as a header like `> x-redwood-request-id: ...` or in the response side as `< x-redwood-request-id: ...`.

sam_ops: CURL alternative that saves headers to a file (easier to paste):
```
curl -s -D headers.txt -o body.txt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

grep -i "x-redwood-request-id\|x-request-id" headers.txt || cat headers.txt
```

alex_h: SDK quick checks for engineers (so they can copy-id quickly):

alex_h: Python (requests):
```
res = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(res.headers.get("x-redwood-request-id") or res.headers.get("x-request-id"))
print(res.status_code, res.text[:500])  # paste status + first 500 chars
```

alex_h: Node (fetch):
```
const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
console.log(res.headers.get('x-redwood-request-id') || res.headers.get('x-request-id'));
console.log((await res.text()).slice(0,500));
```

eng_oncall: Go snippet (for platform folks):
```
resp, _ := http.Post(url, "application/json", bytes.NewReader(body))
fmt.Println(resp.Header.Get("x-redwood-request-id"))
```

maria_s: Also ask them to: 1) provide exact ISO timestamps for the problem window (e.g. 2025-02-10T14:32:10Z to 2025-02-10T14:45:00Z), 2) note which org/project/route name, 3) include the region (us-west-2 etc.), 4) attach screenshots of console errors or billing modal and the billing error id if present.

sam_ops: Request a debug bundle if possible: Console > Settings > Support > "Generate debug bundle". That bundle is safe (API keys redacted) and includes routing traces and infra ids for the window. Tell customers it can take ~30s to build.

eng_oncall: If they cant share raw request bodies for privacy, ask them to paste the request id and a redacted JSON snippet and mark which fields were redacted (e.g., "<REDACTED_EMAIL>"). We need to know what was removed.

maria_s: One more useful thing: ask them to run a single verbose request while capturing timestamps locally so we can correlate network timing:
```
# on Linux/Mac
(time curl -w "\\nSTART:%{time_starttransfer} END:%{time_total}\\n" -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate) 2>&1 | tee curl-debug.txt
```
Then paste the `x-redwood-request-id` plus the START/END times from the output.

alex_h: Quick triage checklist for support reply (copy/paste):
- Times (ISO) + timezone
- Route & model + region
- SDK or curl + snippet used
- `x-redwood-request-id` values (or trace ids)
- Screenshot of error or billing modal (include billing id)
- Debug bundle generated from Console (if comfortable)
- Note any proxy/CDN/VPN or serverless provider in front

sam_ops: Add: If the issue is billing-related, include the billing error id shown in the UI and the last 4 digits of the payment method (never the full card).

support_bot: Created ticket ESCL-4392 and will automatically attach any request ids pasted into this thread. If customer posts request ids, paste them here and the ticket will pick them up.

maria_s: Thanks all — sending condensed checklist now to the customer. Ill paste any headers/ids back into this thread for correlating with the debug bundle.
